reason: The rejected V19 holdout exposed one genuine stochastic omission of a source audience and named scope. V23 explicitly preserves audience, organization, product, deployment, and environment scope in rewritten content. The V19 holdout also contained exact-prose oracles that rejected faithful paraphrases; it is not reused. A corrected three-artifact scope smoke passed before freeze, and a fresh independently authored V21 holdout passed response-blind oracle audit.

v20_holdout.note: The V19 holdout is rejected because exact-prose checks failed natural faithful paraphrases. Its responses were not used as final holdout evidence.

v22_scope_smoke.note: All three responses preserved the named scope. One was rejected by a command-mention ordering oracle, so this smoke is superseded.

development_smoke.note: Supporting pre-freeze smoke only; final treatment runs bind the frozen candidate.

response_blind_holdout_process.semantic_only_disposition: Semantic fidelity, obligation meaning, causal status, typed relations, arbitrary paraphrases, and ambiguity meaning remain in judge_criteria. Deterministic checks cover exact values, protected scopes, field structure, command cardinality, unambiguous order, redaction literals, and no-op equality.
